about.body: The S58 is BMW M's turbocharged 3.0-litre inline-six petrol engine, in production since 2019. It's the current-generation M performance engine, developed specifically for M-badged models — a closed-deck design that shares its basic architecture with the B58 but carries significantly different internals, turbocharger configuration, and engine management to support higher outputs. It's fitted across the current M2 (G87), M3 (G80), M4 (G82/G83), X3 M and X4 M.

byModel.body: Across the M2 range, the S58 powers the current-generation G87 M2 from 2022 onward — the first time this engine has been used in the smallest M car. The M3 (G80) and M4 (G82/G83) have used the S58 since 2020, replacing the previous-generation S55. The X3 M and X4 M (G01 and G02 respectively) have used the S58 since their 2019 introduction — the earliest S58 application in production.

compatibility.body: Because the S58 spans five different M models — coupe, saloon, and SUV applications — compatibility comes down to confirming your exact model, generation, and drivetrain spec, which we do by registration. While the base engine architecture is shared, ancillaries, mounting, and calibration differ between the M2, M3, M4 and the X3 M/X4 M. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm your exact vehicle.
